facts.fact: Salmi, Bouchelaghem and Mohellebi state that in 2018 (2017 in another passage) the health ministry (MSPRH) put the DEMDZ electronic patient record software into certain establishments named pilot hospitals, the Tizi-Ouzou university hospital among them, where the web application was installed in April 2019 at the Belloua unit for the thoracic surgery service; the paper gives no count of pilot hospitals and describes no routine use.
facts.system: DEMDZ (dossier électronique du malade en Algérie)

facts.fact: Salmi, Bouchelaghem and Mohellebi state that at the Tizi-Ouzou university hospital the use of DEMDZ was a failure, the thoracic surgery team finding shortcomings that made it hard to use, and that at the time of writing only the laboratory and radiology parts of a computerised patient record were developed and in use there; the paper gives no date for this, so its publication year 2022 is used, and it speaks for this one hospital only.
facts.system: DEMDZ (dossier électronique du malade en Algérie)

facts.fact: Salmi, Bouchelaghem and Mohellebi state that the health ministry (MSPRH) itself put DEMDZ in place in the pilot hospitals from 2018, and that the Tizi-Ouzou hospital's IT service reported the application's anomalies to the ministry's information systems directorate for correction and updates.
facts.system: DEMDZ (dossier électronique du malade en Algérie)
